presentation.label: INPUT PRE SENDS
presentation.summary: Takes the external inputs’ delay and reverb sends before their LEV, so the inputs can go fully wet to the FX.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt derives IN L and IN R’s delay and reverb sends from the level after their External Mixer LEV, so turning LEV down also silences what they send to the effects. With SETTINGS > INPUT SENDS PRE ticked, the inputs’ sends are taken before LEV instead (still after PAN): LEV sets only the dry inputs on the mains, and at LEV 0 the inputs reach the delay and reverb fully wet. The sends then match what stock sends at LEV 127. Unticked, the render runs exactly the stock instructions. Tracks 1-8, DUAL MONO and every other mixer setting are unchanged.
highlights: IN L and IN R send to the delay and reverb independently of their LEV.
LEV 0 gives a 100% wet input: the effects only, no dry signal on the mains.
Unticked, the mixer is stock; tracks are never affected.
usage: Connect a source to IN L and IN R, open the External Mixer (FUNC + LFO until its page) and turn the inputs' DEL or REV up so you hear the effect.
Turn IN L and IN R LEV down to 0. With the row unticked (stock) the inputs and their effect go silent.
Open SETTINGS and tick INPUT SENDS PRE. The dry inputs stay silent, and the delay and reverb now get them as if LEV were at full: 100% wet.
Raise LEV again to blend the dry inputs back in; the sends stay the same. Untick the row to return to stock post-fader sends.

steps: Use a build containing Input Pre-Fader Sends for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go to the INPUT SENDS PRE row with UP/DOWN.
Press YES to tick it (PRE) or untick it (POST, stock). LEFT and RIGHT also untick and tick it.
Press FUNC + LFO until the External Mixer page, and set IN L/IN R LEV, DEL and REV as usual.

controls.name: INPUT SENDS PRE
controls.doc: Ticked: IN L and IN R’s DEL and REV sends are taken before their LEV (after PAN), as at LEV 127. Unticked: stock post-fader sends. Unticked at every power-on; not saved with the project.

limitations: The setting is not saved: it starts unticked (stock) at every power-on and is the same for every project and pattern.
PRE sends are taken after PAN, as the stock sends are.

load.display: Adds 0.2% average, 0.3% worst-case of an audio block over stock (emulator)
load.conditions: Emulator: OS 1.54 on Core 2.1, 3,000 audio blocks timed with the MCF5441x instruction-timing model at 250 MHz, zero-wait memory, row ticked. Stock: 60.3% average, 60.7% worst block; with the module 60.5% and 61.0% (unticked 60.5% and 60.9%). The handlers run on all ten mixer channels every block, so the cost does not depend on the pattern. Not a hardware measurement.

hardware.summary: draadpiraat flashed the module-alone build and a build with Digi Health and Digi EQ on their Digitakt I, OS 1.54, about 5 minutes each: the row appears, at LEV 0 the inputs are silent unticked and fully wet ticked, LEV changes only the dry signal when ticked, no clicks when switching, tracks unchanged, unticked after a power cycle; the combined build “checks out correctly”.
limitations: Project save/load, pattern changes and sampling from the inputs not tested.
The combined build’s steps were reported together, not one by one.
Firmware was not read back from the device.

tests.summary: Author hardware (Digitakt I, OS 1.54, module alone and with Digi Health and Digi EQ) and emulator: unticked is stock, ticked sends the inputs to the delay and reverb regardless of LEV, no clicks, tracks unchanged. Project save/load and sampling not tested.
